summary.en: Pakistan suffered two recent train derailments, one killing four and injuring dozens near Multan and another killing six and wounding forty in central Pakistan. Afghanistan and Pakistan exchanged accusations of cross-border terrorism, with Pakistan blaming Taliban fighters for attacks from Afghan soil and the Taliban accusing Pakistan of baseless claims while reporting a rise in arrests of residents and students after a Panjshir blast. The Taliban announced that 681 Afghan migrants have returned home via four border crossings. The EU launched a €5 million border security project in Pakistan while promoting labour mobility. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistan har opplevd to nylige togulykker, den ene drepte fire og såret flere titalls i nærheten av Multan, og den andre drepte seks og såret førti i sentrale Pakistan. Afghanistan og Pakistan utvekslet beskyldninger om grenseoverskridende terrorisme, der Pakistan la skylden på talibanere for angrep fra afghansk jord, mens talibanene anklaget Pakistan for grunnløse påstander og rapporterte en økning i arrestasjoner av innbyggere og studenter etter en eksplosjon i Panjsjher. Taliban kunngjorde at 681 afghanske migranter har vendt hjem via fire grenseoverganger. EU startet et grense­sikkerhetsprosjekt på fem millioner euro i Pakistan samtidig som de fremmet arbeidsmobilitet. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
